**Security: pass-with-notes** at `eb37f6a4aa586205da2711b0fc297c0efdf4759b`.

No reportable security vulnerability found in the scoped `0eb47a4..eb37f6a` repair. Merge-only implementations were excluded.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| 0 | None | N/A | N/A | No reportable vulnerability | N/A |

Details URLs are parsed into numeric job IDs for ordering, not fetched or passed to subprocesses (`harness/scripts/pr-freeze.ts:137-175`). PR/URL fields do not introduce shell, CLI-option or SSRF paths.

Worktree reuse now checks detached state, full expected head and clean status (`pr-freeze.ts:232-258,427-443`). Local Git-produced paths remain single argv operands after `-C`; PR metadata cannot choose them. Unusable/taken destinations are refused without cleanup, reset or checkout.

The missing-parser fallback now requires a present, passing latest named delivers check (`pr-freeze.ts:395-414`). The CLI entry guard compares module/invocation realpaths without shell execution (`520-533`), including the symlinked-invocation test path.

**Retained boundaries:** URL shape does not authenticate the check app or actual job identity; ordering still trusts GitHub rollup metadata. No demonstrated attacker-controlled exploitation path was found. Prior argv/no-shell and fetch notes stand: explicit SHA sources with `--no-tags`, no destination refspecs/refmap override; normal-config branch/tracking nonmutation, not zero filesystem writes or an unconditional all-ref guarantee. Full FINAL-guard correctness and invocation cost remain separately reviewed.

No scoped C19/C21 exposure found; parameterized temporary fixtures and own-layout references are permitted.

**Proof:** exact-head CI [42391070697](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42391070697), attempt 1, passed all four jobs. Node 22 and Node 24 logs each record 21 pr-freeze tests passing. Test source was inspected, including the symlink child-process case; advertised local mutation checks were not independently rerun. No local builds/tests, shim/script execution, fetches, worktree mutations, credentials or live probes.
